
  SESSION
    help                  Show the command index

  LOG
    list                         List every queue
    create    <queue>            Create a log or task queue
    update    <queue>            Change a mutable queue parameter
    describe  <queue>            Show a queue's stored, effective, and default specs
    delete    <queue>            Delete a queue and its directory
    append    <queue> <payload>  Append one record to a log queue
    read      <queue> <offset>   Read the record at one offset
    tail      <queue>            Follow a log queue from an offset
    truncate  <queue>            Drop closed log segments below an offset

  TASK
    enqueue   <queue> <payload>  Enqueue a task
    dequeue   <queue>            Lease the next due task
    ack       <queue> <task>     Acknowledge a task
    nack      <queue> <task>     Return a task for redelivery
    extend    <queue> <task>     Extend a task lease forward
    dlq       <queue>            List dead-lettered tasks
    dlq-ack   <queue> <task>     Remove a dead-lettered task
    archive   <task>             Move a task to its archive log

  ADMIN
    metrics   [flags]     Show a live telemetry snapshot
    login                 Store a token for a target
    logout                Forget a stored token
    bench                 Run and inspect benchmarks

  Run `mikyu <verb> --help` for flags and examples.
